issues.title: PVOS-601 — Python Validation Tool Evolution
issues.objective: Evolve the existing Python v0.1 Validation / Support Track into a repeatable engineering validation tool without gaining Product authority.
scope: Improve the validation workflow and documented entry path
Enhance evidence reports while preserving stable check identities and fingerprints
Verify repeatability across equivalent evidence runs
Refine usage workflow, prerequisites, roles, and maintenance boundaries
out_of_scope: Product placement, geometry, capacity, warning, error, or result calculation in Python
Replacement of C# Mainline or creation of a second PVOS Engine or Runtime
PVOS 2.x, Product Scope, Blueprint, PVOS 1.1/1.2 status, EOS, Governance, Canonical or Legacy Promotion
deliverables: Python Validation Tool Evolution Evidence Package
acceptance_criteria: One repeatable usage workflow identifies prerequisites, immutable input, report output, and failure semantics
Equivalent evidence produces equivalent findings and deterministic report identity
Source and execution inspection prove Python remains Validation / Support Track only
required_evidence: Existing tool inspection and usage workflow
Evidence report, repeatability, unit, integration, and negative results
Team usage, maintenance boundary, C# non-replacement, and changed-file proof

issues.title: PVOS-602 — Golden Dataset Expansion Next Phase
issues.objective: Expand the PVOS Golden Dataset with additional admitted bounded scenarios and improved regression coverage.
scope: Review and admit additional bounded scenarios with factual provenance
Improve regression coverage for approved boundary cases and roof variations
Apply one explicit scenario admission process before Golden authority is assigned
Register immutable inputs, outputs, comparison rules, hashes, and non-claims
out_of_scope: Introduction of unapproved Product behavior or silent Product Scope change
Confidential data admission, automatic roof interpretation, UI, Cloud, Electrical, Construction, or PVOS 2.x
Product Blueprint, PVOS 1.1/1.2 status, EOS, Governance, Canonical or Legacy Promotion
deliverables: Golden Dataset Next Phase Evidence Package
acceptance_criteria: Every admitted scenario has provenance, Product authority, bounded claim, non-claims, and PM admission
Every admitted asset has immutable identity, comparison rules, and matching SHA-256
C# regressions validate existing Product behavior and isolate failures by scenario
required_evidence: Existing scenario inspection and admission matrix
Golden asset registry and C# regression results
Integrity, repeatability, changed-file, and excluded-scope audit

issues.title: PVOS-603 — Runtime Result Package Evolution
issues.objective: Evaluate and evolve the Runtime Result Package evidence boundary without creating an unapproved delivery surface.
scope: Review the Result Package structure and field lineage
Review evidence packaging and immutable references
Review compatibility with current C# contracts, CLI, validation evidence, and read-only consumers
out_of_scope: API, serialization, database, service, UI, or Cloud commitment or implementation
Recalculation, repair, reinterpretation, or replacement of Runtime-owned Product results
PVOS 2.x, Product Blueprint, PVOS 1.1/1.2 status, EOS, Governance, Canonical or Legacy Promotion
acceptance_criteria: Every candidate Result Package field has a traceable Runtime or evidence source
Versioning and compatibility considerations are explicit without committing an API or format
Consumer rules preserve Product result membership, order, geometry, status, warnings, errors, count, and capacity without recalculation
required_evidence: Current Result Package and Runtime contract inspection
Field lineage, evidence packaging, versioning, and compatibility review
No-API, no-UI, no-Cloud, no-recalculation, and changed-file proof
